recommendation: Keep the source fix. It preserves the approved FHIR-31493 semantics while aligning the guidance with the current Evidence resource shape after FHIR-31866.
issue_request: FHIR-31493 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding Statistic.numberAffected as a 0..1 unsignedInt plus revised guidance distinguishing numberAffected from numberOfEvents and using the statistic Count code when the count itself is the statistic.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was applied to R5 through HL7/fhir#1164. Git commit 2bc640fae886d02cf2585a1f361fd74d1b5e235b ("J#31369 and J#31493") added numberAffected and revised numberOfEvents on the old Statistic datatype source.
additional_context: FHIR-31866 later removed Statistic as a standalone datatype and reincorporated its elements into the active Evidence resource. The current build has Evidence enabled in source/fhir.ini, no current Statistic StructureDefinition source, and the statistic type element is now Evidence.statistic.statisticType. That refactor copied the FHIR-31493 comments forward with stale Evidence.statistic.type.coding references.
reconciliation: Updated source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml in the numberOfEvents and numberAffected comments to point Count-code guidance at Evidence.statistic.statisticType.coding.code and Evidence.statistic.statisticType.coding.display. The existing numberAffected element, cardinality, type, and event/participant-count semantics were left intact.
source_changes: source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml: replaced stale Evidence.statistic.type.coding.code/display references with Evidence.statistic.statisticType.coding.code/display in the numberOfEvents and numberAffected comments.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same PR/commit as FHIR-31493 to add Statistic.category; cited for original Statistic datatype context but not independently decided.
